Refereeing body admits error in decisive Manchester derby goal

The Professional Game Match Officials Limited (PGMOL) has stated that the decision to award a decisive goal in the Manchester derby was incorrect. Howard Webb, head of PGMOL, reportedly sent a verdict confirming the error. The incident involved a VAR review during the match between Manchester United and Manchester City. Youri Tielemans commented on Manchester United's performance in the derby defeat.
